text_block_list.name: Fan Near the Stage
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san! Do your best! <chrname>! We came to 
cheer for you!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So many people have come to watch the 
stage performance today as well, haven't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
......Yes, indeed. Desire is a potent 
drug, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hope is what dares to look into the 
possibility of "what if?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, wishing that it "would be so" 
only layers expectation upon mere 
possibility.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The masses are foolish. Without even 
making that distinction, they project 
their own desires onto others.
choice_data_list: But she can turn that into strength, too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you going to change into your 
outfit, Tachyon? The performance is about 
to start.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, pardon me! My, you really are quite 
honest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That is likely why she experiences such 
honest growth. ...She made for quite a 
wonderful sample."

The Umamusume, including <chrname>, gather one 
after another beside the stage for the 4th 
Event.

Hoping that this Live, too, would nourish 
their growth, the Trainer sent them out 
onto the stage.
